purpose: Canonical navigable index and append-only decision history for research continuity. Read this journal before proposing another COSMOS detector change. Each stage keeps its own exact receipts, code, protocols and artifacts; this index pins their observed versions and does not replace them.

source_snapshot.selection: JSON paths containing both COSMOS and SETI available in registry at creation

rules.append_only: Append a new event for each launch, calibration lock, result, failure, correction, hold or next hypothesis; do not erase earlier negative outcomes. Separate stage receipts may be updated with new verified results; pin old blob or commit here. Never record unobserved results as PASS.
reproducibility: frozen protocol and calibration lock hash
calibration and evaluation target IDs and data hashes
source/algorithm donor and external comparator refs
negative results; technical errors and fixes
production adoption and independent validation state
scientific_limits: new targets with artificial injections are not independent real positive sources
compare matched inputs and report realized controls
no posterior origin classification without independently sourced labels
GitHub Actions SUCCESS is not a scientific PASS
comparison with CPU kernels does not imply beating full pipelines
no production change until separately approved and validated

events.decision: 36 fixed policies selected solely on 2 calibration targets; 4% router budget; use 4 new targets, fixed hybrid and conservative fixed hybrid comparators; independent common-input BLISS job.

events.hypothesis: Star Forge lane learning and disjoint unseen-slice traversal may help schedule COSMOS search strategies under a finite compute budget.
events.decision: Preserve original source; investigate lane routing as scheduling only, not a change to calibrated detection truth. Reward must use independently verified localization/control outcomes per cost, not raw score maxima.

mechanics: five lanes DAWN ORBIT KYBER MERCY GROGU
EMA 31/32 history + mean + best + strong hit rate + capped shares + exploration + jitter
coprime stride within each disjoint slice and permutation of slices
replan queued for next unseen slice, no cursor reset

events.limitations: Original is SHA256 nonce traversal, not radio detection; lane choice changes order only, not hash truth. Learner resets per job. No evidence of cryptographic prediction or COSMOS sensitivity gain. No repeat only within a fixed job and fixed traversal schedule; physical data overlap must be handled separately.
events.next_gate: After R28B results, test donor scheduler on fresh labelled calibration and fixed eval tasks, compare fixed routing, exhaustive search, budgeted coverage and equal control rate; shared preprocessing and independent held-out targets. Do not learn from evaluation truth.

events.decision: Retain fixed full hybrid as reference; repair BLISS separately; no promotion.

events.decision: Five distinct native search lanes, calibrated signed reward, fixed and contextual scheduler matched proxy budgets; no label adaptation on exam.
events.limitations: Synthetic injections; no fresh external origin labels; timing proxy not actual equal CPU; KYBER is classical template not FractalGPT.
events.next_gate: Seal frozen lock, paired outcomes, unique coverage, actual cost and failure logs.

events.hypothesis: False alerts cluster by target/acquisition regime; calibrate joint detection statistic on matched controls and add frozen path confirmation, RFI-family and ambiguity evidence, retaining raw candidates.

calibrate by acquisition regime, no label-dependent stratum
reverse cadence and empirical control occupancy
family morphology and OFF evidence, advisory not veto
empirical null and predeclared statistical controls, adapt to block-preserving radio nulls
adversarial competing model expansion, abstain rather than assign unknown origin

events.decision: R30A first diagnostic on viewed R29 artifacts, then R30B fresh target/day/scan-disjoint calibration plus held-out exam; compare full R28 (not failed Star Forge), matched acquisition strata, frozen split-time path confirmation, matched null max over entire search; 3-way candidate/hold/RFI evidence, no destructive deletion. Preserve BLC1/Voyager and shared-signal challenges.
events.limitations: Observed control alerts are empirical proxies, not verified RFI labels or true FAP. Concentration does not establish cause. Old R26C sparse strata and leakage negative results remain; no independent physical origin calibration. No new experiments executed.
events.next_gate: Preregister new target/source split and calibration-only thresholds; comparative goal fewer controls at noninferior localization and weak recovery, matched realized false-alert diagnostics, report coverage and total costs.

events.hypothesis: Frozen independent validation, leave-one-block stability, source-provenance passports and overlap-safe evidence counting may reduce unnecessary alarm escalation without changing full R28 discovery.

donors.role: HANNAH provenance-bound feature passport and nearest known RFI fingerprint; advisory only
leave-one-time-block score stability; flag fragile tracks, never posthoc remove observations
overlap-safe event counting with scan/source failure domains; nonoverlap alone is not independence
freeze candidate trajectory before checking separate scan/epoch; no recentering; no coverage != rejection
shape vs scale diagnostic, avoid assuming transferable gain

events.decision: Prioritize R30A diagnostic and R30B fresh evaluation: calibrate max of full pipeline including all lanes and overlapping windows with matched real controls and block-preserving nulls; sparse regimes abstain/fallback. Add separate frozen confirmation and stability/overlap/provenance ablations; report discovered vs escalated recall and controls including HOLD, keep raw records. HANNAH use measured RFI labels and feature overlap; no automatic origin veto from similarity. Compare same examples and counts with paired group-aware uncertainty; preregister operating point on calibration only. Relative goal halve control escalation at no loss in localized and weakest positive escalation; if filtering only, cannot recover more than its input. Preserve BLC1 detection and RFI-origin distinction and Voyager shared-signal tests.
events.limitations: Source inspection, not radio adaptation or performance measurement. KUSTO original bathymetry, TOPA original geography, HA10 original acoustics/seismology. Prior R22 donors not newly invented; old HA10 positive control failed 1/8 vs minimum 3 and shape-vs-scale transfer failed (11/19 within 3 dB). Control alerts are not verified ground-truth RFI. R29 already viewed; only development diagnostic. No new experiments or detector changes.
events.next_gate: R30A design freeze; R30B fresh target/day/source-disjoint calibration and evaluation; compare baseline, KUSTO, TOPA, combined, held-out confirmation, and advisory passport/stability separately. Report paired deltas and group-aware uncertainty, total runtime, known-signal retention; no production promotion.

events.hypothesis: Shared acquisition-day or receiver noise regime contributes to control alerts
events.decision: Exclude R29 selected targets and five observed days; enforce unique day across every new target and all fit/null/exam splits. Do not tune using viewed R29 positives.
events.limitations: Two problem targets share date; no causal proof, no true RFI labels; correlation within day and tile.

events.hypothesis: Reference-only KUSTO regime calibration and TOPA empirical joint null based on four time-block support will halve control alerts without reducing localized or weak recovery
events.decision: Separate research path; freeze 2 fit, 4 null, 4 evaluation targets on distinct days; seven arms incl pooled strict, protected union, tile max; no destructive deletion or production change.
events.limitations: No R30 performance measured; day-disjoint archive synthetic injections are not external physical source evidence; selected-path support not independent; BLC1/Voyager and HANNAH deferred; exact errors and source hashes in receipt.
events.next_gate: Inspect manifest, lock, job and artifacts; seal positive/negative findings and paired deltas. Only then R30C HANNAH.
